our_interpretation: Assess the three firm observations, not the separate suggestion that neurosymbolic AI might offer a better solution.
The ordinary reading is that neurosymbolic AI occupied a marginal position relative to mainstream neural AI, lacked mature broadly usable systems, and attracted comparatively weak venture backing.
The claim concerns the field, not the finances of a named company, so metric_scope is null.
Use the current public state during early 2023 through the post date. Earlier research and investments can provide background but cannot alone establish that state.

criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable evidence establishes substantial mainstream prominence, mature broadly deployed systems, or strong field-wide venture backing, contradicting the corresponding component.
